technical-summary: Policy driver CALIBRATING mode, off by default: structural settings from declared facts, a pure probe module (static placer plan, tail-involved and positive predicted gain only, ramped by factor two from one expert stride and capped by the smallest helper budget), probes only until the record settles, then Driver::adopt swaps in settings derived with the shared derivation between epochs and logs RHP16_POLICY_ACTIVE. The helper reports its calibration record under the launch identity without requiring the lab profile. Nothing sets the calibrating mode yet; the manifest wiring follows.
